historicalBaselines.notes: Face values and purchase dates confirmed from Tim's Ticketmaster order emails. All early bird purchases made ~June of the prior year (12 months out). Ticketmaster fee model changed: 2023–2024 had explicit per-ticket service charges; 2025–2026 fees appear bundled into face value (no separate charge shown). For like-for-like comparison, use orderTotal / ticket qty as the all-in per-ticket cost.

2023.notes: 2 adult + 1 child. Bought Nov 2022 (~7 months out). Service charges explicit on top. All-in per adult = (£215 face + £15 service) = £230, but order total includes child + programme, so blended. Per-adult all-in = (487.50 - 8.25 - 16.00) / 2 = £231.63 approx.

2024.notes: 1 adult + 1 teen + 1 child. Bought Jun 2023 (~12 months out). Service charges explicit: £19 adult, £18.50 teen. All-in adult = £190 + £19 = £209. All-in teen = £185 + £18.50 = £203.50. Ticketmaster fee model still explicit at this point.

2025.notes: 1 adult + 1 teen + 1 student. Bought Jun 2024 (~12 months out). Fees included in price — no separate service charge shown.

2026.notes: 3 × 'Sky presents the Isle of Wight Weekend Adult Ticket' — all show as Adult GA. Tim's group (2 adults + teen, teen on adult ticket or same-price tier). Bought Jun 2025 (~12 months out). Sky-sponsored early bird at £231.35 vs standard £368.

twicketsResale.feeNotes: Twickets buyer fee structure: seller listed at £223; Greg offered £210; seller accepted. Twickets adds a buyer fee (~6.2% on accepted price) at checkout. £210 offer + ~£13 buyer fee = £223 total paid. The £223 is the confirmed all-in figure from the purchase confirmation email — no further charges on top.

comparisons.note: Greg's resale ticket (59 days out, offers needed) was £8.35 cheaper all-in than Tim's early bird (purchased 12 months out). However Tim had certainty, no bidding, and secured the Sky-sponsored rate.

twicketsResale.notes: Greg's Twickets resale ticket. Seller: lottiefarrell03@gmail.com. Offer of £210 accepted, final all-in price £223 (incl. Twickets ~£13 buyer fee). Cheaper than Tim's early bird of £231.35 but required active monitoring and offer negotiation 59 days out.
